rules.content:
/*
HellCat ransomware
*/

rule HellCat_Ransomnote
{
    meta:
        author = "ransomware.live"
        family = "ransomware.hellcat"
        description = "Detects HellCat ransomware ransom note"
        date = "2026-05-04"
        severity = 7
        score = 70

    strings:
        $s1 = "HellCat" ascii nocase
        $s2 = "HELLCAT" ascii
        $s3 = "hellcat.onion" ascii nocase

    condition:
        any of them
}
